bs.title: Iscjedak, svrbež, miris: gljivična infekcija ili bakterijska vaginoza
bs.description:

U ovom videu, dr. Senai Aksoy jasno, naučno i pristupačno objašnjava kako razlikovati gljivičnu infekciju od bakterijske vaginoze, zašto se ponavljaju i kada se treba obratiti ljekaru.

en.title: Discharge, itching, odor: yeast infection or bacterial vaginosis
en.description:
Vaginal yeast infection or bacterial vaginosis: these two intimate problems are very often confused, even though they have different causes, symptoms, and treatments.

In this video, Dr. Senai Aksoy explains clearly, scientifically, and accessibly how to distinguish between a yeast infection and bacterial vaginosis, why they recur, and when to consult a doctor.

Essential content for any woman experiencing vaginal discharge, itching, unusual odor, or recurring vaginal infections.

01:04 – The Vaginal Ecosystem and the Role of pH
03:06 – Yeast Infection: Itching, Redness, No Odor
05:18 – Bacterial Vaginosis: Fishy Odor and Bacterial Imbalance

In this video, you will discover:

how to distinguish a vaginal yeast infection from bacterial vaginosis

what the most reliable symptoms are

why vaginal discharge, odor, itching, and vaginal pH are so important

why some intimate infections recur despite treatment

the possible role of the partner, the gut microbiota, and probiotics

why a medical diagnosis remains essential before any treatment

This video is for all women who have questions about:
vaginal yeast infection, bacterial vaginosis, vaginal discharge, vaginal odor, vaginal itching, vaginal flora, vaginal microbiota imbalance, recurrences, treatment of bacterial vaginosis, treatment of bacterial vaginosis Yeast infections, feminine intimate health, infertility, and prevention of gynecological complications.
